name: ingredient-parser-ts
description: Bit-parity TypeScript port of strangetom/ingredient-parser (pinned at ffd6ae3, release 2.7.0)

scripts.model: node training/extract-model.mjs && node training/extract-ff-assets.mjs && node training/precompute-ff-caches.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm model && rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm model && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.harness: pnpm model && HARNESS=full vitest run tests/harness
